services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Enjoy Portland from the water on this relaxed, island-style sunset cruise along the Willamette River. At approximately 2 hours, this cruise blends scenic views, tropical vibes, and a welcoming atmosphere for a memorable evening on the river. As the sun begins its descent, you’ll embark on an enchanting journey along the Willamette River: Cruise past floating homes, historic riverside properties, Waverly Country Club, and glide under 10 iconic bridges as the sky shifts with sunset colors and the city reflects on the water.
